latest_release.name: v4.4.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: clamp topK to available classes in classify() by @GantMan with @Copilot in https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs/pull/933
* fix: publish source maps and add package regression check by @luojiyin1987 in https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs/pull/935
* fix source map error and added tool-versions by @jonmajorc in https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs/pull/936
* exclude .tool-versions from published npm package by @jonmajorc in https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs/pull/937

## New Contributors
* @GantMan with @Copilot made their first contribution in https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs/pull/933
* @luojiyin1987 made their first contribution in https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs/pull/935
* @jonmajorc made their first contribution in https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs/pull/936

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs/compare/v4.3.0...v4.4.0
